# vasosofuji, Mateja Vasojevikj

> Photographer and cinematographer based in Skopje, North Macedonia. Concert
> and live music coverage, portrait sessions, landscape work, short-form video,
> and bespoke web development. Also known as Mateja Vasojevich and Матеја
> Васојевиќ.

Contact: contact@vasojevich.com
Location: Skopje, North Macedonia - also shooting regularly in Ohrid.
Languages: English, Macedonian (the site has a language toggle; both render
from the same URL, so there is one canonical address per page).

Bookings are made through the calendar on the home page: available dates are
selectable, booked dates are marked, and submitting the form sends an enquiry
by email.

## Pages

- [Home](https://vasojevich.com/): Hero collage, featured work from each
  category, showreel, and the availability calendar used for booking.
- [Gallery](https://vasojevich.com/gallery): Entry point to the
  three photo categories.
- [Portraits](https://vasojevich.com/portraits): Portrait sessions
  shot in Skopje and Ohrid. Each frame lists camera, lens and location.
- [Concerts](https://vasojevich.com/concerts): Live music
  photography from Skopje venues including MKC, Laboratorium and Kotur.
- [Landscapes](https://vasojevich.com/landscapes): Landscape work
  from Lake Ohrid, Vodno and around North Macedonia.
- [Videos](https://vasojevich.com/videos): Short films, music
  videos and brand advertisements.
- [About](https://vasojevich.com/about): Background, gear, and
  recent projects.
- [Collaborations](https://vasojevich.com/collaborations): Artists,
  venues, festivals and organisations worked with.
- [Web development](https://vasojevich.com/webdev): Web development
  and motion engineering services.

## Equipment

- Fujifilm X-T2 with Fujinon 35mm f/2 and Fujinon 16-50mm f/3.5-5.6
- Canon 2000D with Canon 50mm f/1.8

## Notes for machine readers

- Photo captions on the gallery pages carry the camera, lens and location for
  each frame, and are the authoritative source for that metadata.
- Structured data (schema.org Person and ProfessionalService) is embedded as
  JSON-LD on the home page.
- The site is a static build; there is no API and no user accounts.
